title: Ethereal Figure with Scarab
description: A white line-drawn figure with a headdress and antlers sits in a meditative pose, holding a branch of blooming orange and white flowers from which a blue scarab beetle emerges. The figure is positioned within a circular magical sigil on a dark textured ground scattered with golden rings, while glowing orbs float in the upper right against a black background.
prompt: A surreal mystical scene on a solid black background featuring a white line art figure with antler headdress and serene expression sitting cross-legged inside a large circular magical sigil. The figure holds a branch bursting with orange and white flowers and green leaves, with a vibrant blue scarab beetle on its chest. Glowing white orbs float in the upper right. Dark textured ground at the base is scattered with golden rings. Ethereal smoke and detailed botanical elements, high contrast, symbolic and magical atmosphere.
